CVE-2025-15538.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.2. CVE-2025-15666.title: A security vulnerability has been detected in Open Asset Import L ...
CVE-2025-15666.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 5.4.3. Affected by this vulnerability is the function Assimp::SceneCombiner::Copy of the file code/Common/SceneCombiner.cpp of the component Model File Handler. CVE-2026-111128.title: Assimp through 6.0.5 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerab ...
CVE-2026-111128.description: Assimp through 6.0.5 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the Ogre3D importer that allows attackers to crash applications via unvalidated bone indices in OgreStructs.cpp. Attackers can supply a crafted .mesh and .skeleton file referencing a missing bone, causing BoneById() to return null and crash the host process.

CVE-2026-111129.title: Open Asset Import Library (assimp) through 6.0.5 contains a NULL  ...
CVE-2026-111129.description: Open Asset Import Library (assimp) through 6.0.5 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the Ogre3D binary mesh importer's OgreBinarySerializer::ReadAnimationKeyFrames() handling of unvalidated animation track targets. Attackers can supply a crafted .mesh file with a morph animation track targeting a missing submesh or absent shared geometry to crash the host process.

CVE-2026-117608.title: Assimp through 6.0.5 contains an integer overflow vulnerability i ...
CVE-2026-117608.description: Assimp through 6.0.5 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in MD2Importer::ValidateHeader() that allows attackers to bypass frame table bounds checks using crafted header fields. Attackers can supply a malicious .md2 file whose numFrames and numVertices values wrap the 32-bit size check, causing heap out-of-bounds reads that crash applications or expose adjacent heap memory.

CVE-2026-129477.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in t ...
CVE-2026-129477.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the glTF and glTF2 importers that allows attackers to read local files via crafted buffers[].uri values. Attackers can supply glTF models with '..' segments or absolute paths in buffer URIs to load files like /etc/passwd into imported mesh vertex data.

CVE-2026-129478.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerabi ...
CVE-2026-129478.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in glTFCommon::Util::ParseDataURI caused by storing the data offset in a signed char. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF file with a raw data URI whose segment starts beyond byte 127 to crash applications or leak adjacent heap memory.

CVE-2026-129479.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an integer overflow vulnerability i ...
CVE-2026-129479.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in OgreBinarySerializer::ReadSubMesh that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying crafted Ogre binary .mesh files. Attackers can set a large index count so the 32-bit buffer size wraps, causing a segmentation fault in aiMesh::~aiMesh() during scene teardown.

CVE-2026-129480.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerabi ...
CVE-2026-129480.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in MD2Importer::InternReadFile that allows attackers to read past the file buffer via an unvalidated stored frameSize header field. Attackers can supply a crafted .md2 file loaded with a non-zero keyframe selected to crash the application or leak adjacent heap memory into the imported mesh.

CVE-2026-134732.description: A flaw has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.5. Patch name: 7ccc44a338dcdcc81023484388126ab1a8250e94. You should upgrade the affected component.

The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

CVE-2026-134859.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerab ...
CVE-2026-134859.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in PLYImporter::LoadFace and PLYImporter::createFromeTriStrip that fails to validate face vertex indices against the vertex count. CVE-2026-134860.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability ...

Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose animation accessor describes more values than its float_array holds to read past the array or dereference null, crashing the importing application.

CVE-2026-134861.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerabilit ...
CVE-2026-134861.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in glTFAsset.inl that allows attackers to corrupt memory via oversized glTF 1.0 accessor elements. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with VEC4 position or VEC3 index accessors to overflow heap or stack buffers during import, crashing applications.

CVE-2026-134862.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability ...
CVE-2026-134862.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that uses NORMAL and TEXCOORD accessors without comparing their counts to the POSITION vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with shorter normal or texture coordinate arrays to trigger heap out-of-bounds reads and writes that crash the importing application.

CVE-2026-134863.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an invalid pointer dereference vuln ...
CVE-2026-134863.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an invalid pointer dereference vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportEmbeddedTextures that derives the texture format hint without checking the strchr result. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with an embedded image mime type lacking a slash to crash the importing application.

CVE-2026-134864.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use of uninitialized resource vul ...
CVE-2026-134864.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that builds TRIANGLE_STRIP and TRIANGLE_FAN faces from unfilled faces. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file whose strip or fan primitives trigger out-of-bounds reads or null pointer dereferences, crashing the importing application.

CVE-2026-134865.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability ...
CVE-2026-134865.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ColladaParser::CopyVertex that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying primitives lacking a VERTEX input. Attackers can provide a crafted Collada file whose SIZE_MAX per-vertex offset bypasses the release-removed ai_assert check, crashing the importing application.

CVE-2026-134866.title: Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerabilit ...
CVE-2026-134866.description: Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SkipLine that allows attackers to hang parsing by supplying files with '#' comment lines. Attackers can provide crafted OFF, LWS, or MD3 shader files so ReadFile never returns, consuming a CPU core and denying service.

CVE-2026-134867.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation v ...
CVE-2026-134867.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in FBXConverter::GetRotationKeyframeList that allows attackers to exhaust memory via unbounded rotation angle differences. Attackers can supply a crafted FBX file of about 111 KB whose keyframe interpolation loop never advances, consuming gigabytes of memory until the importing process is killed.

CVE-2026-136170.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use-after-free and double free vu ...
CVE-2026-136170.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in OpenGEXImporter.cpp because InternReadFile does not reset cached importer state between files. Attackers can supply OpenGEX files to applications reusing one Importer instance, causing freed node, camera, and material pointers to corrupt heap memory and crash.

CVE-2026-136171.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in B ...
CVE-2026-136171.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in BVHLoader.cpp that allows attackers to read freed aiNode objects because the mNodes vector is never cleared between files. CVE-2026-136172.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerab ...
CVE-2026-136172.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the OBJ exporter that allows attackers to corrupt memory via NaN vertex components breaking comparator ordering. Attackers can supply a crafted PLY file with NaN texture coordinates or vertex colors that, when exported to OBJ in libc++ builds, writes file-controlled data past a heap buffer and crashes the application.

CVE-2026-136197.title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability ...
CVE-2026-136197.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the glTF 1.0 importer that allows attackers to read adjacent heap memory by supplying an unchecked KHR_binary_glTF image bufferView. CVE-2026-136198.title: Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an invalid mesh reference vul ...
CVE-2026-136198.description: Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an invalid mesh reference vulnerability in glTF2Exporter::ExportMeshes that causes out-of-bounds access when meshes without faces are skipped during export. CVE-2026-136909.title: Assimp 5.1.0 through 6.0.6 contains a memory leak vulnerability i ...
CVE-2026-136909.description: Assimp 5.1.0 through 6.0.6 contains a memory leak vulnerability in AMFImporter::ParseFile that overwrites the previous XML parser pointer without releasing it. Attackers can supply repeated AMF files to applications using a long-lived Assimp::Importer to retain parsed documents and exhaust memory.

Attackers can craft an .md5mesh file with out-of-range face vertex indices or unfilled faces to set bits past the abHad allocation, read vertex data out of bounds, or crash the application.
